name: qlrisk_stress_test
title: Stress testing
description: Stress a book: mode library (qlrisk's crisis scenarios), custom (your shocks or stylised definitions) or reverse (the move losing target_loss). Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "mode": "custom", "custom_scenarios": [{"name": "risk off", "definition": {"equity_pct": -20, "rates_bp": -50}}]} gives 1 stress scenario(s); worst risk off P&L -230,866.48 USD on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
